AiPhoneKVM screenshot helper — GNU GPL version 3.
Corresponding source: https://github.com/wyang1212/AiPhoneKVM

Unchanged runtime dependencies:
OkHttp / okhttp-android 5.3.2 — Square and contributors; Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/square/okhttp/tree/parent-5.3.2
Okio / okio-jvm 3.16.4 — Square and contributors; Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/square/okio/tree/parent-3.16.4
Kotlin standard library 2.4.0 and JetBrains annotations — JetBrains and
contributors; Apache-2.0. https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin
AndroidX annotations 1.9.1 and startup/tracing — Android Open Source Project
and contributors; Apache-2.0. https://github.com/androidx/androidx

GPL-3.0.txt and Apache-2.0.txt are bundled with this application.
DEPENDENCIES.json enumerates its resolved runtime dependency graph.
The helper, enrollment and enhanced-input application code was added for
AiPhoneKVM. Third-party libraries are used unchanged and keep their licenses.
The controller application derives from Atharok/BtRemote and
jqssun/android-bt-remote; see the source distribution NOTICE.md and
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for their retained attribution and all component details.
